title: Find out why the held-out set lost points on 2026-11-05
goal: The score for requests Ask has never been tuned on fell from 68.4 to 62.7 the day icon tweaks landed, mostly because more drawings ran out of time. Nobody knows yet whether that is the change, the way the run was done, or chance, so the next reading has to say.
notes: Not reproduced, one reading. Scripts/ask-eval.sh time 20261105-214708-ask-held-out 20261105-055127-ask-held-out printed drawing 4 of 36 ran out of time, 3 stopped part way, 149s median, against 1 of 36, 2 stopped, 147s; redline 33.8 against 44.1 over 3 cases, a group that read 33.2 and 33.6 earlier this week. Three extra zeros are about 4.7 of the 5.7 points. Prompts for anything but an icon did not change in 7c581639 or f0e55cc4, and restyle_icon is offered only on a picture holding an icon. Held-out icon requests of something breaking would take the new route, which cannot be told from totals. The run was resumed in about sixteen pieces of six minutes, each restarting the probe; that is a guess at the cause, not a finding.
acceptance: The held-out set is read again on current code and its total and time-outs are written in this task
If time-outs are back near 1 of 36 this is closed as chance, with both readings named
If they stay high, the cause is found from totals and timing only, without reading held-out cases one by one

log.note: digest 2026-11-06: one held-out reading also serves ask-s-redlines-do-at-least-as-well-on-unseen-req, so take it once for both. It was not run again for ask-animates-what-it-makes-an-animated-svg-icon (about 2.4 hours), so 62.7 is still the latest total.

Another reading: 20261107-013327-ask-held-out, on an-icon-picture-s-svg-reads-in-24-whole-units, total 59.7 against 62.7 on 2026-11-05 (drawing 62.9 from 66.1, layout 47.7 from 49.7, redline 30.3 from 33.8, video 63.1 from 63.8). That change only touches icons, so layout, redline and video falling too points at something else as well. No control run on the parent commit was made, so its share of the drawing drop is not known.
